hooks.prompt: A task was just completed. Check: was this an implementation task (code was written/edited)? If YES, and if testing/live-proving has NOT yet been done for this task, remind via systemMessage to run /simplify on the changed code before moving to tests or live-proving. The /simplify skill reviews changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency. If the task was not implementation (e.g. research, planning, config) or tests have already run, no reminder needed. Return JSON: {"systemMessage": "..."} with the reminder, or {} if not needed.

An Agent subagent just completed. IMPORTANT: You MUST return valid JSON only. NEVER return a stopResponse — always allow the conversation to continue. Check the CURRENT message (not previous turns): were TWO OR MORE agents launched IN THE SAME MESSAGE to work on overlapping files or shared interfaces? If YES, return {"systemMessage": "Multiple agents developed in silo — audit combined changes for gaps: stale references, mismatched interfaces, duplicate handlers, naming mismatches."}. In ALL other cases — single agent, sequential agents across turns, agents on independent concerns, plan mode exploration — return exactly: {}
